items.summary: CTO review: approve containment-only execution. Continue only existing failure repair-or-close, period-aligned measurement and attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. No new production work, requeues, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spend, monetization expansion, or unsupported claims. Preserve deferred SEO, UX, accessibility, performance, content, affiliate, attribution, and repository opportunities until ownership, isolation, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, measurement capacity, security, and attribution gates are satisfied. Keep the gated product private and external outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and explicit owner authorization.

Existing queue work may continue only within its current isolated scope. Retained failures require documented ownership, root cause, smallest repair, deterministic validation, rollback, and deduplication before requeue. Measurement work must preserve unknowns and keep aggregate revenue unattributed. Security evidence remains read-only; missing operational and fleet-doctor results do not establish clearance.
